mintAuthority.summary: SAFO's Ethereum token and Permission Manager are UUPS-upgradeable, with the PM ADMIN group controlled by a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe at 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea. Pinned block 26095796 confirms that token mint permission accepts ADMIN or group 2. The removed historical EOA 0x60a98f4b7d6e3f0b71d9ad3dd74b6a416f00c84a is not the complete mint-group census: six contract addresses currently hold group 2, including the verified native Minter proxy 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366. Two group-10 EOAs can initiate native minting through this proxy within a shared 5000000-share daily limit; six group-9 EOAs and a 1-of-4 Safe can approve pending mints without that daily-limit check. ADMIN can raise the limit or upgrade the token, PM and Minter, so these operational controls do not bound ultimate mint capacity. Five additional group-2 contracts return BurnWithFromMintTokenPool 1.6.1 and identify other configured fund tokens, not SAFO, at Ethereum block 26098894. Their broad PermissionManager mint grant is retained as observed; configured-token-only execution still requires deployed-source equivalence before they are removed from the unresolved native-path candidates. Solana native issuance is now traced at finalized slot 452345677: the configured admin vault is a 1-of-1 Squads path, and its sole member also retains the minter program upgrade authority. These are verified single-signature controls; daily operational limits are bypassable through admin approval and replaceable by a program upgrade.

controls.label: Spiko native Minter proxy — Ethereum group 2
controls.capDescription: Pinned dailyLimit(SAFO) is 500000000000 raw shares (5000000 shares at decimals 5), and maxDelay is 86400 seconds. initiateMint requires ADMIN or group 10; exceeding the daily limit creates a pending request. approveMint requires ADMIN or group 9 and executes a pending mint without the daily-limit check. setDailyLimit requires ADMIN. These mutable, bypassable operational limits do not bound ultimate ADMIN mint or upgrade power.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796, PM getGroups(proxy) includes group 2 and canCall(proxy, SAFO token, mint selector 0x40c10f19) returned true. The Minter proxy authority is PM 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472, its implementation slot is 0xd4f4fb505b8c3c3cf3c39947246b2cafa10fe043, and the corrected EIP-1967 admin slot is zero. PM getRequirements(proxy, upgradeToAndCall) returned ADMIN mask 1; the fetched verified implementation calls token.mint in initiateMint and approveMint. R05 Ethereum execution review at block 26124840 / 0x204633afc218623e2a2753eb9219585d01fde70c5fa58c24545c5bc6234d090c: independent PM history census from creation 19690257 recovered 697 events, 108 current requirement pairs on 30 targets, and all 256 group-admin masks (only group 6 adds group 5). Current privileged membership matches census. Minter, PM, both native tokens and all 11 implementations of the 17 group-2 mint targets exactly match verified deployed source bytecode. Token mint/burn/pause/UUPS all check the immutable PM using msg.sender; the trusted forwarder cannot call restricted functions, token owner is zero, proxy admin/beacon slots are zero, and self-delegatecall Multicall does not evade permissions. Minter token arguments are mutable: full root/native-liability reach and the independent ADMIN ability to change permissions, limits and implementations are retained; no deployment-local cap, collateral guarantee, signer independence or module noninterference credit is asserted. Group-9 approveMint/cancelMint and group-10 initiateMint are the only restricted Minter routes; approve requires a matching pending operation and bypasses daily limits. Both fund tokens have a 500000000000 raw-unit daily limit (5000000 shares), maxDelay 86400 is an expiry, not an unavoidable execution timelock. Approver Safe has four zero-code owners, threshold 1, terminal empty modules, zero guard/module guard, singleton 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a and handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, both runtime/source exact; simulateAndRevert cannot persist effects. Admin Safe independently remains 3-of-6; no custody attribution inferred. Complete scope applies only to the seven narrowly-permissioned group-9/group-10 principals; Minter, richer-role callers and ADMIN system inventory remain partial.
